name: Svetlana Igorevna Petrova
bio:
Svetlana's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, inheriting her grandfather's small auto repair shop near a rural rally course. She quickly developed a passion for the materials science behind racing machines, captivated by the blend of artistry and engineering in composite design. After years of hands-on experience, she pursued formal training in advanced composite manufacturing, earning recognition for her innovative repair techniques.

Svetlana's approach to composite work is meticulous and forward-thinking. She's known for her ability to identify subtle flaws and devise unconventional yet effective solutions. Her management skills ensure projects are completed efficiently, and her team members are well-supported. Svetlana's visionary mindset makes her a valuable asset, always pushing for innovation and exploring new possibilities in composite technology.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often with strands pulled back from her face
physical.description: Svetlana has a strong, focused gaze and a practical but feminine appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of a materials science textbook.
Insists on using traditional Russian folk music to focus during complex repairs.
Meticulously organizes her tools by size and function, labeling each with custom-made tags.
